title: chrysothamnus parryi subsp. attenuatus
intro: Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. attenuatus, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Chrysothamnus or California Chrysanthemum, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. attenuatus include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their medicinal properties.
